subject: Renewal + Expansion: invoice recipient swap and PO onboarding
messages:
From: Samira Al-Khatib <samira@olivetech.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@olivetech.com
Date: Mon, 01 Jul 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + expansion: invoice recipient and PO process

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the renewal summary you sent last week. We are prepared to move forward with the 18-month renewal and the additional 50 GPU-hours/month capacity add-on, but procurement needs two things locked before generating our PO:

1) Invoice recipient — our billing org is changing. Invoices should go to: OliveTech Inc. — Accounts Payable, ap@olivetech.com.
2) Legal entity / tax paperwork — we need your current W-9 and an EIN for Redwood Inference to validate the PO.

I'd like to get the PO out by end of week so we can keep the July 15 start. Can you confirm you can accept the PO to the new invoice recipient and attach the W-9? Also confirm whether PO number can be routed to your finance@ address or if we should use the billing contact on the contract.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Al-Khatib
Head of Cloud Platform Operations
OliveTech
[phone: +1-415-555-0199]

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: Samira Al-Khatib <samira@olivetech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 01 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion: invoice recipient and PO process

Hi Samira — thanks, and great to hear you're moving forward. Short answers below, but looping in Marissa (finance lead on this account) and Vivek (CS/renewals).

- Invoice recipient: we can route invoices to ap@olivetech.com. We'll update the billing contact on the account and set the invoice delivery email to that address.
- W-9 & EIN: attached is our current W-9 and the legal entity on the agreement is Redwood Inference, Inc. EIN: 82-1234567.
- PO routing: procurement can send PO to finance@redwood.com and please include the customer billing contact in the PO body. We will route the PO internally to Marissa for invoice processing.

If procurement needs the PO to reference a specific billing contact name on our invoices, let us know the preferred payee string.

Next steps:
- I'll update the account billing email this afternoon.
- Marissa will confirm whether we need any additional tax docs for a foreign-subsidiary invoice (if OliveTech requires it).

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_W9_2028.pdf (pdf)]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal + expansion: invoice recipient and PO process

Aditya / Vivek — forwarding Samira's note and your reply. A couple of internal items for finance ops before we confirm:

- Need to confirm Entity on invoice (Redwood Inference, Inc.) and payee line. Samira asked to bill to "OliveTech Inc. — Accounts Payable" at ap@olivetech.com. That's fine; we will issue invoices to that email.
- Please confirm whether PO numbers should be recorded on the invoice header or in the invoice notes for their AR system. OliveTech sometimes requires the PO on the invoice header and matching on import.
- I will need a signed SOW or commitment doc showing the capacity addition to attach to the invoice batch — can we publish the amended SOW to the shared Drive link?

I'll prepare the AR workflow once you confirm the prefered PO placement and drop the SOW link.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@olivetech.com>
To: procurement@olivetech.com, Samira Al-Khatib <samira@olivetech.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 04 Jul 2028 07:35:00 -07:00
Subject: OliveTech PO 78934 (Redwood renewal + capacity add)

Team — attached is OliveTech PO #78934 covering the 18-month renewal (base commit) and the capacity uplift. Please note:

- Invoice recipient: OliveTech Inc. — Accounts Payable (ap@olivetech.com)
- PO line items reference SOW version v2.0 (Renewal + 50 GPU-hours)
- Net terms: Net 45 (per corporate policy)
- Billing contact for disputes: Rajesh Patel, rajesh.patel@olivetech.com

[Attachment: OliveTech_PO_78934.pdf (pdf)]

Samira — please confirm once Redwood confirms PO placement on invoice header.

Thanks,
Rajesh

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@olivetech.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 06 Jul 2028 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OliveTech PO 78934 (Redwood renewal + capacity add)

Rajesh / Samira — thanks for the PO. We received OliveTech PO_78934 and have recorded it to deal D-98433. Confirmations below:

- Invoice routing: invoices will be sent to ap@olivetech.com (per request). We will place the PO number on the invoice header (Invoice: PO #78934) to support your AR import.
- Net terms: Redwood will honor Net 45 for this renewal; finance will reflect Net 45 on the invoice payment terms.
- Tax docs: W-9 received (attached by Aditya) and on file. No additional tax doc required for a US-based payor. If OliveTech needs an alternate payee or a specific EIN mapping, please confirm now.
- SOW: Vivek, can you upload the signed amended SOW (v2.0) to the shared Drive link so I can attach it to the invoice batch?

We will issue the first invoice the week of July 15 for the pro-rated portion of capacity and the renewal commit, then move to monthly invoicing per the contract.

Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[Internal note: finance ticket #FIN-1127 opened to process PO 78934]
